ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 95% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels with sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters localized at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes with high-contrast white focal clusters mapping to the distal tips and localized white spotting appearing as discrete coordinates across the lower mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 75-degree V-shaped notch with a depth of approximately 15% of the fluke's total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 2 to 10 pixels; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced jagged peaks compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the outer distal margins of both fluke lobes.
